references.text: God's promise to Abraham to give the land to his descendants, fulfilled in Joshua 21:43
God's covenant with Abraham where He promises to give the land from the River of Egypt to the Euphrates to his offspring
God confirms the promise to Isaac to give him and his descendants all these lands
God confirms the land promise to Jacob, that the land will be given to him and his offspring
Moses reminds God of the oath He swore to Abraham, Isaac, and Israel to give the land to their descendants
Moses commands the people to go in and take possession of the land that the Lord swore to give to the fathers
The promise that the Lord will bring them into the land He swore to give to the fathers
The Lord shows Moses the land He swore to give to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob
God's promise to Joshua that every place they set foot on will be given to them, just as He promised Moses
Joshua took all the land as the Lord had said to Moses, and gave it as an inheritance to Israel
Joshua confirms that all the good promises of the Lord have been fulfilled
The book of Hebrews refers to the rest that Joshua gave the people, pointing to the true rest in Christ
